scope: HA/client 0.3.0 firmware preflight and standard update service, isolated tests only
verified: Authenticated preflight uses GET only and filters unknown/private report fields
Malformed, contradictory, wrong-candidate and incomplete executable reports are rejected
Executable reports require current live-session identity and all schema-1 prerequisite checks
Options flow presents and refreshes the report without installing or changing options
Actual options flow through real native HTTP API opens no UART, starts no job and changes no database rows
Standard update.install requires advertised capability and fresh matching candidate/board/version evidence
Blocked preflight, transport failure or changed push state prevents installation submission
A started update retains one durable request ID through acceptance, uncertainty and confirmation
Older daemon firmware status and native switch entities remain available while preflight-dependent installation is disabled
Existing detection, switch control, packaging and client regression tests pass
limits: No live HA host or radio was contacted, updated or flashed
Successful firmware job tests use a stubbed worker and synthetic qualification report
This does not qualify any physical firmware image, Nordic automatic lifecycle or recovery procedure
Public 0.3.0 release installation and upgrade validation remains a separate release gate
